basic_info.description: This spacious home blends timeless charm with modern comforts. The sunlit main level features a gracious living room, elegant dining room with built-in china cabinet and wainscoting, and an updated kitchen with new counters and abundant storage. Three bedrooms and two baths upstairs include a magnificent spa-like ensuite with Jacuzzi tub, walk-in shower, and double sink vanity. A with a private deck flows effortlessly into the expansive sunny yard. The lower level offers two additional bedrooms, a full bath, and open living spaceperfect for guests, office, or multigenerational living. This home delivers comfort and versatility in a coveted location close to parks, schools, and neighborhood shops.
